title: refactor: drop the hidden-fallback EXIF model mask
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Removes the `hiddenFallback` branch in `generateMediaWithFallback` and the now-dead `metadataModel` parameter it fed through `generateImageResult` → `createAndReturnImageCached`.
- `metadataModel` reached only `prepareMetadata` → `writeExifMetadata` (EXIF `Make` + `UserComment`); generation itself always used the real `safeParams`. The returned `params` reached only `mediaHeaders`, where `x-model-used` comes from `trackingData.actualModel` (`zImageFalModel.ts:76` always sets `"zimage-fal"`). No change to headers, R2 cache key (URL-derived), dedup, cost, or price — cost still follows `servedModelEntry`, price still follows the requested model.
- `hidden` means unlisted, not secret (`registry.ts:204`, `model-registry.ts:211-214`), and the current behaviour was inconsistent: a direct `?model=zimage-fal` request already wrote that id into EXIF, since `entry` is only populated on fallback candidates (`fallback.ts:202-220`).
- The served id is public anyway via `x-model-used` / `x-fallback-target`, both persisted and replayed by the media cache; #13523 deliberately kept `x-model-used` naming the served model.
- Added in #13006 for `flux-replicate`, which no longer exists; `zimage-fal` is the only remaining `hidden: true` entry. No test asserted the mask — `test/image/zImageFalFallback.test.ts`, `test/image/zImageFalModel.test.ts`, `test/fallback.test.ts` (21 passed) and all of `test/image` (265 passed) are unchanged and green, as is `npm run typecheck`.

gist.headline: No more model costumes
gist.blurb: The image pipeline stopped carrying a spare EXIF disguise for fallback models. Metadata now follows the same public served-model trail the headers already use.
gist.summary: Removed the dead hiddenFallback/metadataModel path so image EXIF metadata no longer uses a fallback-only model mask; generation, cache keys, costs, prices, and x-model-used headers remain unchanged.
gist.impact: Model metadata is now consistent between direct and fallback image requests, while existing generation behavior and cached responses continue as before.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli tidying a cozy image-processing garden: an old unused mask is being placed in a compost bin while a retro camera prints a photo with a clear model label. The scene represents removing metadata-only indirection while preserving the real generation path and public headers.
